narrative.northStar: Animated banner with native GitHub text
narrative.overview: The uploaded GIF supplies a full-width animated banner. Native headings, prose, technology names, and links make the profile easy to read. The existing grayscale activity heatmap and footer complete the page.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width GIF with preserved animation and proportions.
Native project title and technology names.
Original About me, links, responsive heatmap, and footer.

rules.name: Host styling
rules.body: GitHub controls the native page styling; the GIF keeps its colors and the heatmap keeps its grayscale palette.

dos: Preserve the uploaded GIF and its proportions.
Preserve the author's prose and the existing link labels and destinations.
Let text wrap on phones and keep the heatmap mobile source.
donts: Do not replace technology names with icons or badges.
Do not add a welcome heading or a project illustration.
Do not replace real contribution data with placeholders.
